t: Ezo melakot yakol hannokri laasot bead hayyisrael
s: Ezo melakot yakol hannokri laasot bead hayyisrael ubo k"b seipim: ap al pi sheasur lehanniach lenokri sheyyaaseh melaka leyisrael beshabbat, ap al pi sheoseh besakar im hu oseh betorat sekir yom, kegon shessekaro hayyisrael qodem hashshabbat veamar lo bead kol yom veyom shettaabod li etten leka kak vekak, ap al pi shello amar lo sheyyaabod gam beshabbat ella meatzmo hu obed — tzarik hu limchot beyado, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"g, abal im hu oseh betorat qabbelanut, sheqqibbel alayv laasot kak vekak bead sakar kak vekak, ben sheoseh mishshello, ben sheoseh mishshel hayyisrael, shennatan lo mimma laasot hammelaka, kegon shennatan lo beged litpor veqatzatz lo sakar, o shennatan lo chutin leerog lo beged, ben sheqqibbel alayv leerog kol habbeged, ben shello qibbel alayv kelal leerog kol habbeged, ella sheqqatzatz lo bead kol amma veamma sheyyeerog — muttar lehannicho sheyyaaseh kol melakto beshabbat. Vaapillu lekattechilla muttar litten lo apillu beereb shabbat samuk lachasheka, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman rn"b, ap al pi sheyyodea shehannokri yaaseh beshabbat (ubekak hu chapetz), mikkol maqom hannokri eno oseh bishbil tobat hayyisrael ella bishbil atzmo, lemaher lehashlim melakto kede leqabbel sekaro. Veeno domeh liskir yom, shehassekir yom en hammelaka shello kelal, veen lo eseq bah, shehare en kavvanato baabodato kede lehashlim hammelaka, shehare lo alayv hammelaka ligmor, veen lo toelet kelal behiggomrah, ella kavvanato laabod et hayyisrael kol hayyom kede sheyyitten lo sekaro, lepikak hare zeh keoseh shelichut hayyisrael, abal haqqabbelan hammelaka hi shello, shekkavvanato baabodato hi lehashlim hammelaka kede littol sekaro, veeno kishlucho shel yisrael. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher shello yaaseh bebet hayyisrael, veshello yomar lo sheyyaaseh beshabbat, vegam sheyyiqtzotz lo damim qodem hashshabbat, vegam shello yitten lo ella im ken beinyan sheyyukal hannokri laasot kol hammelaka bechol im yirtzeh qodem hashshabbat o leacharayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rn"b, ayyen sham kol perate dinim ellu:

Bammeh debarim amurim shemmuttar lehanniach leqabbelan nokri laasot beshabbat? Kesheoseh melaka bedabar hattalush min haqqarqa, shehannokri yakol laasotah bebeto o bemaqom acher sheeno reshut hayyisrael, veen haddabar nikkar shehi meleket hayyisrael, veen kan chashash marit haayin. Abal kesheoseh bimchubbar laqqarqa, kegon sheqqibbel alayv libnot bayit leyisrael, o liqtzor sadeh leyisrael, kevan shehaqqarqa geluya umepursemet lakkol shehi shel yisrael — nikkar haddabar lekol roeh sheggam hammelaka hi shel hayyisrael, lepikak im hu betok hair o betok techumah — asur lehannicho sheyyaaseh beshabbat, mippene marit haayin, sheharoeh yomar shehu sekir yom etzel hayyisrael. Vaapillu im en haddabar mepursam lakkol sheqqarqa zo hi shel yisrael, mikkol maqom yesh lachush lemarit haayin shel shekenayv, shehem yodeim sheqqarqa zo hi shello, veenan yodeim shehannokri haoseq bimlaka hu qabbelan, ella yomru shehu sekir yom. Vaapillu im hu dar bikpar ben hannokrim sheen lo sham shekenim yisrael, mikkol maqom im oseh betok techum hakkepar — yesh lachush shemma yizdammenu lo sham orechim sheyyishbetu etzlo veyiru et hannokri oseq beshabbat beqarqa hayyisrael, veyachsheduhu shehannokri sekir yom etzlo. Vegam yesh lachush libne beto, shehem yodeim shehammelaka hi shello, veyachshedu oto shehannokri hu sekir yom etzlo. Abal kesheoseh bedabar talush, ap shemmiqtzat yisrael yodeim shehammelaka hi shel yisrael — lo gazeru chakamim, kevan sherob happeamim en haddabar noda laacherim kelal, shemmeleket talush en lah qol kelal, mah sheen ken kesheoseh bimchubbar shehu bemaqom galuy umepursam, verob happeamim hammelaka geluya umepursemet larabbim, shemmeleket mechubbar yesh lah qol, lepikak im lipamim en chashash marit haayin ella mimmiqtzat yisrael gazeru chakamim:

Vekol zeh kesheoseh hammelaka betok hair o betok techum hair, sheyyekolin anshe hair lelek lesham beshabbat, abal kesheoseh hammelaka chutz lattechum, vegam en ir acheret sheyyisrael darim bah tok techumayv shel meqom hammelaka — muttar lehannicho sheyyaaseh beshabbat:

Apillu meleket talush, im hi mepursemet vidua larabbim shehi shel yisrael, vehi naaset bemaqom galuy umepursam, kegon binyan hassepina, shedderek libnotah al sepat hannahar shehu meqom parhesya — asur lehannicho laasot beshabbat, mippene marit haayin:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bispina vekayyotze bah middebarim sheshshem hayyisrael niqra alehem, sheomerim dabar zeh hu shel peloni. Abal dabar sheen shem hayyisrael niqra alayv, raq sheoseh beparhesya, venitparsem larabbim sheddabar zeh naaseh beshabbat letzorek hayyisrael, kegon yisrael shessakar lo nokri beqabbelanut laasot lo kelim chadashim veasa otam beshabbat beparhesya, sheap sheyyatza haqqol venitparsem larabbim sheoseh bishbil hayyisrael, mikkol maqom adayin lo niqra shemo alehem lihyot niqraim kelim shel peloni, kevan sheadayin lo bau lirshuto meolam, lepikak ap sheoseh bemaqom galuy umepursam — eno tzarik limchot beyado meiqqar haddin. Umikkol maqom, tob lehachamir velimchot beyado lachush lerinnun shaa, shello yaronnu acharayv lomar shennokri oseh melaka beshabbat bishlichuto:

Apillu laasot betalush, im hu letzorek mechubbar, kegon lipsol haabanim uletaqqen haqqorot kede leshaqqeam bebinyan — tzarik limchot beyado im hu betok hattechum, apillu oseh rachoq mehabbinyan, vaapillu oseh bebeto sheen haddabar nikkar sheoseh bishbil binyan zeh shel hayyisrael, mikkol maqom kevan shessopan leshaqqeam behabbinyan — hare dinam kehabbinyan atzmo:

Veim lo micha beyado veasa beshabbat beqabbelanut — yesh lehattir leshaqqeam babbinyan, veken habbayit shennibna beshabbat beqabbelanut — muttar lehayyisrael likkanes ladur bo, lepi sheyyesh mi shemmattir qabbelanut nokri vaapillu bimchubbar, ukeday hu lismok alayv bediabad. Abal nokri sekir yom shebbana beshabbat — nakon lehachamir shello yikkanes bo shum yisrael leolam. Vaapillu im keshessakar et hannokri leyamim hitna immo shello yaaseh beyom hashshabbat vehannokri asa meatzmo, (ve)im asa letobat hayyisrael — nakon shello yikkanes bo shum yisrael leolam. Abal im nitkavven letobat atzmo — muttar apillu lebaal habbayit ladur bo, kevan shehitna immo shello yaaseh beshabbat:

Biqtzat meqomot nohagin hetter shehaqqahal sokerim nokrim beqabbelanut lepannot hazzebel min harechob, vehannokri oseh leatzmo vaapillu beshabbat, veen chosheshin lemarit haayin. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut, lepi shekkebar nitparsem haddabar shedderek liskor nokri beqabbelanut lepannot hazzebel velo sekir yom, veim ken en kan chashash marit haayin, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"g leinyan merchatz tannur verechayim, ayyen sham. Umittaam zeh yesh lehattir lehanniach lenokrim libnot bet hakkeneset beshabbat, im hu maqom shemmepursam bo derek binyan habbattim al yede ummanim qabbelanim, velo al yede sekire yom kemo shehu berob hammeqomot, shehaadrikal lebaddo hu qabbelan vehaummanim ose melaka shettachtayv hem sekire yom, sheshsham yesh chashash marit haayin. Umikkol maqom, en lehattir ella bishat haddechaq, kegon sheyyesh chashash shemma yitbattel behemshek hazzeman binyan bet hakkeneset legamre mechamat rishat hannokrim. Abal shello bishat haddechaq — en lehattir, mippene chillul hashshem beene hannokrim, shehem enam mannichim leshum adam laasot melaka beparhesya beyom edam, veanu mannichim laasot melaka beshabbat bishbilenu beparhesya. Abal kibbud harechob eno niqra al shem hayyisrael kol kak, veen bo chillul hashshem, laken nohagin lehattiro ap shello bishat haddechaq. Umikkol maqom, bemaqom sheen sham minhag — en lehaqel ap bekibbud harechob:

Mi shessakar lo nokri leshana o lishtayim sheyyiktob lo o sheyyeerog lo bekol et sheyyitztarek betok zeman meshek sekiruto, kemo shehu derek hassarim sheyyesh lahem soper meyuchad shekkoteb lo kol et shetztzarik, ukesheen tzarik hu yosheb batel — muttar lehannicho sheyyaaseh beshabbat mah shetztzivva lo qodem hashshabbat (raq sheyyizzaher shello yomar lo sheyyaaseh beshabbat) im eno oseh bebet hayyisrael, lepi sheen leyisrael revach bemah sheoseh beshabbat, sheim lo yaaseh beshabbat yaaseh achar hashshabbat. Veap im hammelaka tzerika lo bemotzae shabbat miyyad, mikkol maqom en zeh niqra revach ella hanaa beolma, verevach hu kegon shehammelaka hayeta mitbattelet legamre im lo hayeta naaset beshabbat, sheaz hu marviach hammelaka al yede shennaaset beshabbat, ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman rn"b, veken im yesh lo revach acher sherkusho mitravveach umitrabbeh al yede shennaaset hammelaka beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"g:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen hayyisrael maqpid immo kelal im hu yosheb ubatel leachar shetztzivva lo laasot hammelaka, ella beyado laasotah bekol et sheyyirtzeh, lepikak keshehu oseh beshabbat — ledaat atzmo hu oseh velo mechamat hayyisrael. Abal im hu maqpid immo al bittulo — hare hu oseh beshabbat mechamat hayyisrael, lepikak tzarik hu lomar lo shello yaaseh beshabbat. Veim ap al pi ken hu oseh — eno tzarik limchot beyado, shelledaat atzmo hu oseh:

Vekol zeh kesheen hannokri muskar lo ella limlakot meyuchadot, kegon liktob o leerog bekol et sheyyitztarek, veachar sheggamar hammelaka hu yosheb ubatel, abal im sekaro lekol hammelakot sheyyitztarek betok meshek zeman sekirato — asur lehannicho sheyyaaseh beshabbat, lepi shehayyisrael marviach melaka zo beshabbat, shehare kesheyyihyeh panuy achar hashshabbat yitztarek laasot melakot acherot. Veen lehattir mippene shehannokri oseh letobat atzmo kede leqabbel kol sekaro, shehare ap im lo yaaseh beshabbat lo yenakkeh lo kelum, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"g. Veyesh mattirim gam bazeh, lepi shehannokri eno maaleh al dato shehayyisrael eno makricho laasot beshabbat veshello yenakkeh lo kelum missekaro ap im lo yaaseh kelum beshabbat, ella hu oseh meelayv lepi tummo lehashlim qabbelanuto sheqqibbel alayv bitchillat sekiruto laasot kol hammelakot sheyyitztareku leyisrael bekol meshek zeman sekiruto, kede sheyyeshallem lo kol sekaro mishshalem velo yihyeh lo alayv shum taromet. Veen lismok al sebara zo (mittaam shennitbaer sham), ki im leinyan deleqa mishshum hepsed, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"d, uleinyan shelichut iggeret, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rm"z, ayyen sham hattaam:

Yisrael haqqoneh mekes — asur lo leqabbel mekes beshabbat, apillu hebio debar maakal sheeno muqtzeh verauy laakila, kegon shehuba mittok hattechum, vehu dabar sheen bo chashash shemma nilqat hayyom mehamchubbar o shemma nitztzad hayyom — ap al pi ken asur lo leqabbel beatzmo, mishshum shenneemar "mimmetzo cheptzeka", chapatzeka asurim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"v. Ella soker lo nokri beqabbelanut, dehaynu sheomer lo likshettigbeh mea dinarim etten leka kak vekak. Abal lo yiskor lo nokri leyom hashshabbat, shekkeshehannokri hu sekir yom — hare hu kishlucho shel yisrael, mah sheen ken beqabbelanut sheeno kishlucho shel yisrael, ella leatzmo hu toreach kede leharbot sekaro. Veap al pi shehayyisrael qobea lo melakto sheyyaaseh beshabbat — en bazeh mishshum amira lenokri shebut, lepi sheqqabbalat hammekes en bah issur apillu leyisrael ella mishshum shebut, vahare zeh shebut dishbut, sheyyesh mattirin oto bimqom hepsed, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"z. Veap sheyyesh oserin ap bimqom hepsed im lo letzorek mitzva kemo sheyyitbaer sham, mikkol maqom kan chashub debar mitzva, sheim lo yittol hammekes mehannokri beshabbat lo yukal ligboto achar hashshabbat, veyishtaqqea hammamon beyad hannokri, vahare hu oseh mitzva bemah shemmatztzil hammamon miyyadam, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman qm"t vesha"b:

Apillu im hu mekes shetztzarik laasot bo melaka gemura, kegon shetztzarik liktob — ap al pi ken muttar lomar lenokri sheyyitasseq bo beshabbat beqabbelanut, lepi sheadam bahul al mamono, veim lo nattir lo amira lenokri yabo lehitasseq beatzmo, veshemma yishkach veyiktob, lepikak mattirim lo issur amira lenokri shehu middibre soperim kede shello yabo lide ketiba haasura min hattora:

Veken muttar lo lehaskir lenokri et hammekes sheyyittol leatzmo mah sheyyigbeh beshabbat hen rab hen meat vehu yitten leyisrael dabar qatzub, shennimtza shehu toreach leatzmo, veeno kishlucho shel yisrael. Ukeshemmaskir hammekes lenokri, veken keshessoker lo hannokri beqabbelanut — en chosheshin lemarit haayin sheharoeh yomar sekir yom hu etzlo, lepi shebbimqom hepsed gadol lo gazeru al marit haayin. Veap im lipamim hu hepsed muat, mikkol maqom kevan sheal harob derek lihyot hepsed gadol bimniat qabbalat hammekes beshabbatot — lo chillequ chakamim, vehittiru legamre gezera zo shel marit haayin bemekes ubekol kayyotze bazeh shedderek lihyot sham hepsed gadol al harob:

Ukeshemmaskir hammekes lenokri — yakol lehaskir lo leyom hashshabbat bilbad shello behablaa im shear hayyamim. Veeno domeh lemerchatz sheasur lehaskiro leshabbat bilbad kede shello yittol sakar beshabbat shello behablaa, lepi shehammerchatz gupo qanuy lo ap beyom hashshabbat, ukeshehannokri noten lo sakar bead merchatz shello shehaya muskar lo leyom hashshabbat — hare mistakker hayyisrael bemerchatz shello beshabbat, vahare zeh niqra sekar shabbat, veasur littelo shello behablaa, mah sheen ken bemekes vekayyotze bo shekkeshehiskiro lenokri leyom hashshabbat hare mekaro lo legamre leyom zeh, veen kan sekar shabbat kelal, sheen hannokri noten lo sakar kelal, ella qana mimmennu legamre leyom zeh, vahare zeh domeh lemi sheyyodea sheyyabiu lo sechora beshabbat umokerah lenokri meereb shabbat sheyyeqabbelenna lemachar leatzmo, sheen bezeh mishshum sekar shabbat:

Veken yisrael shessakar hammatbea mehammelek — yakol lehaskiro lenokri leyom hashshabbat, sheen bezeh mishshum sekar shabbat, sheen hannokri noten lo sakar kelal bead dabar shehu shello beshabbat, shehare hakkol hu shel hammelek, ella shehareshut bilbad sheyyesh leyisrael mehammelek hu shehiskir lo, vahare mekaro lo legamre leyom zeh. Veken yakol liskor lo nokri beqabbelanut, al derek shennitbaer bemekes. Veap al pi shemmashmiim qol beshabbat behakkaat hammatbea — en bekak kelum, kevan shekkebar hiskiro lannokri, o shessekaro lo beqabbelanut:

Veasur lehayyisrael o shelucho lesheb etzel hannokri bishat qabbalat hammekes o hammatbea, ap al pi shekkebar hiskiro lo veen lehayyisrael shum eseq bo, mikkol maqom keshehu yosheb etzlo hare hu nireh keoseh bishbilo uletzorko, veasur mippene marit haayin. Veim sakar lo et hannokri beqabbelanut umityare shemma yignob harbeh, kevan sheyyesh chashash hepsed merubbeh — yakol lehoshib etzlo yisrael o lesheb beatzmo leshomro shello yignob, shebbimqom hepsed merubbeh en chosheshim lemarit haayin:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyisrael hayyosheb eno mashgiach umeayyen al hannokri raq sheyyanniach hakkol letebat hammekes o hammatbea velo yignob leatzmo kelum, abal asur lo leayyen veleda mah hu hahitassequt sheoseh hannokri kede liqqach mimmennu cheshbon al zeh, dekevan shebbeshabbat atzmah asur liqqach mimmennu cheshbon — asur lo gam ken leayyen alayv bishbil hacheshbon shellemachar, shekkol dabar sheasur laasoto beshabbat — asur lehakin ulehazmin et atzmo kede laasoto achar hashshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"v:

Muttar litten kesep lenokri beqabbelanut letaqqen lo maot, vehannokri oseh leatzmo apillu beshabbat. Veap al pi shemmashmia qol beparhesya — en bekak kelum, kevan sheen yadua larabbim shehu oseh bishbil yisrael — en kan chashash marit haayin:

Yisrael shessakar hammelach mehassar leshana, shekkamma melach sheyyaaseh betok hashshana hu shello, vehu soker lo poalim nokrim leshana o lechodesh, veqatzatz lahem sekaram lepi ribbuy melaktam, dehaynu mikkol kak vekak melach sheyyebashshelu noten lahem kak vekak, ap al pi shemmebashshelim bekelim shel hayyisrael — muttar lehannicham sheyyaasu beshabbat, sheen adam metzuvveh al shebitat kelayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rm"v, vehannokrim hem keqabbelanim sheosim letobat atzman kede leharbot biskaran, shehare en sekaram mishtallem lepi hayyamim o chodashim, ella lepi sekum hammelaka sheggomerin, vekak meshallem lahem, nimtza shehem mitkavvenim baasiyyatam beshabbat letobat atzman. (Veap sheim lo hayu osim beshabbat haya maggia hepsed leyisrael, shehare hayyisrael sakar hammelach sheyyebashshel betok shenato, vehayyamim shehechsir velo bishshel mehem en lahem tashlumim, shello yenakkeh lo hassar kelum missekaro, vegam lo yannichennu lebashshel kenegdam beshana haacheret, ubishbil kak keshehayyisrael soker poalim lechodesh o leshana hu maqpid alehem meod shello yebattelu apillu yom echad, vehem mukrachim laasot gam beshabbat mechamat qepedato, mikkol maqom bishbil kak en tzarik limchot beyadam shello yaasu beshabbat, ella day sheyyomar lahem sheenam mukrachim laasot beshabbat bishbilo, veim yirtzu shello laasot beshabbat hareshut beyadam, veim ap al pi ken hem osim mealehem kede leharbot biskaram — en tzarik lomar lahem kelum, ap al pi shemmaggia leyisrael hanaa gedola mizzeh — en bekak kelum, kevan shehannokrim mitkavvenim letobat atzman[)]. Veen leesor mippene marit haayin, lepi sheharoeh eno yodea shebbishshul zeh hu shel yisrael, shehakkelim shemmebashshelim bahem, veken haetzim shemmabirim bahem — en shem hayyisrael niqra alehem, dehaynu sheen mepursam larabbim shehen shel yisrael. Ubilbad shello yabiu etzim mereshut hayyisrael beshabbat, shekkol qabbelanut enah mutteret ella im ken masar lo meereb shabbat kol mah sherotzeh limsor lo letzorek hammelaka. Vaapillu im masar lahem haetzim meereb shabbat, ella shello hotzium mereshuto ad shechoshka — asur lehannicham sheyyotziu beshabbat, mippene marit haayin, sheyyomru shebbeshabbat masar lahem, ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman rm"v, ayyen sham:

Veim hu beinyan sheyyesh chashash marit haayin — en lehattir mechamat hepsed merubbeh sheyyapsid hayyisrael bekol shabbetot hashshana, ella im ken hu beinyan shemmapsid harbeh mikkiso mimmah shetztzarik leshallem lehassar velappoalim veyeter hotzaotayv, abal im hu beinyan shello yapsid kelum mikkiso, ella shemmapsid harevach shehaya yakol leharviach harbeh baasiyyat hammelach gam beshabbatot — en mattirin lo bishbil kak issur shel marit haayin. Veeno domeh lemekes ulematbea sheap im hu beinyan shello yapsid kelum mikkiso, ella mishshum shello yapsid harevach shel hashshabbatot hittiru lo issur marit haayin, lepi shehammekes kebar nitchayyebu bo hannokrim hassocharim haoberim beshabbat litteno lehammelek, vehayyisrael kebar qana chiyyub zeh mehammelek, nimtza sheim lo yittelennu hayyisrael mehassocharim — hare zeh kemapsid harevach shebba kebar lekiso. Veken hammatbeot sheyyaasu ose hammelaka asher lammelek beal korcho shel yisrael, kebar hem qenuyim leyisrael, veim lo yittelem hayyisrael — hare zeh kemapsid harevach shebba kebar lekiso:

Veyisreelim shessokerim mehassar sheyyihyeh reshut beyadam lachpor beharim limtzo heapar sheosim mimmennu barzel, vesorepim vetzorepim heapar yom velayla lo yishbotu ad kelot meshek zeman sekirutam, vesokerim lahem poalim lekak leshana o lechodesh, veqotzetzim lahem sakar kak vekak bead kak vekak barzel — hare dinam kedin soker et hammelach lekol dabar, im hu beinyan sheen lachush lemarit haayin, al derek shennitbaer besimman rm"g ayyen sham. Veken haddin besokere hittuk hazzekukit mehassarim, veken bekol kayyotze bazeh:
